content: Love does not consist in gazing at each other, but in looking outward together in the same direction.
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
sourceWork: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's Essays & Philosophical Writings
story:
Preserved as part of Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of partnership and love. Across his life and work, Antoine de Saint-Exupéry returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: What defensive wall or grudge are you holding onto that is keeping genuine warmth and intimacy away?
